verdict.rationale: The evidence publishes deadlines the founder must meet: a 48-hour payment window, a 24-hour name reservation, 5 days for corrections and 30 days for beneficial-owner data. It also lists standard and urgent fee tiers. None of this states how long the service currently takes to process an incorporation, by transaction type or otherwise, so these deadlines are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
